Understood. I won't mention your application to Ruth, Gideon, or anyone else, and I won't post anything about it in a channel. This DM stays between us.

One caveat: I can keep it out of my own messages, but I can't control what the hiring process itself shares, so the people running the search may still learn of it through that process. If you want help with anything for the application, such as drafting a note or pulling together your materials, tell me and I'll do it here.
